title: Apple, Samsung, and other phone makers don’t think they can sell as many phones in 2027
summary: The smartphone market is bracing for troubled times ahead.
body: TL;DR Most major phone makers have reportedly lowered their 2027 shipment targets due to rising memory costs. Xiaomi and vivo are cutting the most, by 25% and 29% respectively, while Apple and Samsung are also reducing their targets. HONOR is the only major phone brand that’s not reducing its shipment target for 2027. The memory shortage has been a theme throughout this year, and we’ve seen several manufacturers hike phone prices because of it. Now, it seems to be hitting manufacturers’ sales plans as well. According to a report from Jiemian News , citing supply chain sources, most major smartphone makers have finalized their shipment targets for 2027 and expect to sell considerably fewer phones next year.

title: Survey says nearly 3 in 5 readers are already on Android 17, despite low global numbers
summary: That still leaves plenty of devices stuck on older versions, though.
body: It’s been several months since Android 17 made its mainstream debut, but as of October 2026, a tiny percentage of devices were running it. As is so often the case, it takes a while for the latest version of Google’s mobile OS to proliferate across devices, but it’s particularly worrying that nearly four months after launch, just 1% of devices were running it . We just had to know if these broader Android Studio figures matched those of our readers. So, we ran a poll, asking readers which Android version their device is running. The results are in, and it’s a completely different story.

title: Gemini Notebook’s flashcards just got a lot better for studies with three new features
summary: Your flashcards now have a better sense of time than you.
body: TL;DR Gemini Notebook can now incorporate images from uploaded study materials into flashcards, making visual learning easier. Google has added an optional stopwatch to flashcard review sessions to help users practice recalling information under time pressure. You can now schedule flashcard review reminders through the Gemini mobile app, and all three improvements are available without a paid subscription. Google has been adding some interesting features to Gemini Notebook lately. Just a few days ago, we reported that the tool could turn your research materials into interactive websites. Now, Google is improving the flashcard experience with three new features that could make studying more effective and, perhaps more importantly, easier to keep up with. The first change addresses a limitation of text-based flashcards. Gemini Notebook can now pull relevant images from your uploaded study materials and incorporate them into flashcards. This should be handy for subjects where visual references matter. For instance, if you’re studying human anatomy, identifying different parts of the heart from a diagram could be much more effective than memorizing their names from a wall of text.

The feature works by grabbing a screenshot of the page behind it but doesn’t require you to share your screen with Gemini Live. Google already curates products from multiple online stores in the Shopping section of its search results. If you’d rather skip manually scouring products, you can ask Gemini or Google’s AI Mode to recommend or filter them based on your preferences . body: شهدت نهاية مباراة مانشستر سيتي وضيفه نابولي، بملعب الاتحاد، أحداثا ساخنة واعتراضات كبيرة من لاعبي الفريق الإنجليزي وجماهيره. نجا مانشستر سيتي، من هزيمة كانت قريبه على أرضه وبين جماهيره، على يد نابولي، حيث خطف تعادلا قاتلا بنتيجة 2/2، في المباراة التي جمعتهما اليوم الثلاثاء، ضمن الجولة الخامسة لمرحلة الدوري ببطولة دوري أبطال أوروبا.  وبينما كانت المباراة في طريقها للانتهاء بفوز نابولي 2/1، سجل ريان شرقي هدف التعادل لمانشستر سيتي، في الدقيقة 86. وبعدها ضغط السيتي بكل قوة لتسجيل هدف الفوز لكن المباراة انتهت بالتعادل 2/2. وقالت صحيفة " ذا صن "، إن مباراة مانشستر سيتي ونابولي في دوري أبطال أوروبا، انتهت وسط جدل كبير، بعد أن أطلق الحكم صافرته قبل 25 ثانية من نهاية الوقت المحتسب بدلا من الضائع. وخطف رجال إنزو ماريسكا التعادل 2-2 من الإيطاليين في ملعب الاتحاد ليلة الثلاثاء، لكن لاعبي وجماهير السيتي كانوا غاضبين بعد إطلاق صافرة النهاية بينما لا يزال الوقت متبقياً على الساعة الداخلية، حيث بدأوا في الإشارة إلى الساعة. وقاد حارس المرمى جيانلويجي دوناروما موجة غضب لاعبي وجماهير السيتي وحصل على بطاقة صفراء بسبب احتجاجه من قبل الحكم إستفان كوفاتش. 😡 ENOUGH IS ENOUGH! title: Google Photos is forcing some Galaxy users to save every minor edit as a copy
summary: We've reproduced the issue on a Galaxy S23 FE.
body: TL;DR Google Photos is forcing some Samsung Galaxy users running One UI 9 to save even minor edits as separate copies. We’ve independently confirmed the absence of the regular Save option on a Galaxy S23 FE. Samsung has reportedly escalated the issue to its engineers, though it’s still unclear whether this is a bug or an intentional change. Google Photos is forcing some Samsung Galaxy users to save images with simple edits, like minor crops, as their own copies. As you might expect, this is already causing frustration among users who are now stuck deleting unnecessary copies from their Google Photos libraries every time they make a minor adjustment to an image. For reference, the app has traditionally allowed users to simply overwrite original images after minor edits have been made to them. The tech giant recently went as far as letting users overwrite original images even after advanced edits like Magic Eraser, Unblur, or edits with UltraHDR and C2PA formats. That’s precisely why the sudden disappearance of the regular Save option for basic edits is perplexing.

title: Tinkerers are turning old Kindles into DIY weather stations with a little help from AI
summary: Kindles are getting new life after being discontinued.
body: TL;DR Owners of old Kindles have found new life for them as DIY weather stations. After jailbreaking the devices, they’re vibe coding apps that display the weather and other information. As Amazon continues to end support for more Kindles, new uses for old Kindles are likely to become more popular. There is magic in reading a book, but when the device you read it on is no longer useful, you can always conjure it into something entirely different — which is what’s happening right now on the Kindle Jailbreak sub on Reddit. Posters are showing off old Kindles that now act as weather stations thanks to jailbreaking and a little vibe coding. One poster took their 7th-generation Kindle and used Claude for the transformation. They went to kindlemodding.org and followed a guide to jailbreak their device and then added the Kindle Unified Application Launcher (KUAL), an app launcher made for modded Kindles.
